feature: re-prove an amended decision only where it changed
description: Re-accepting a changed spec keeps each unchanged scenario's test, red commit and seal; named scenarios are re-proved alone into a new sealed file, with their old tests removed on the record; and a test that does not build at its red commit counts as red, as `--prove` counts it.

accepted.by: gary (run by Claude on gary's instruction)

specs.description: An unchanged scenario keeps its test and its own red commit
specs.given: a previous spec whose scenario S01 has test `tests/a_spec.rs::s01` and red `abc1234`, and an accepted spec whose S01 has the same decision, kind, description, given, when and then
specs.then: the returned S01 has test `tests/a_spec.rs::s01` and red `abc1234`, and every other field of the returned spec equals the accepted spec's

specs.description: An unchanged scenario proved at the spec-level red gets that red written onto it
specs.given: a previous spec with spec-level red `def5678` whose S02 has test `tests/a_spec.rs::s02` and no red of its own, and an accepted spec whose S02 is identical in decision, kind, description, given, when and then
specs.then: the returned S02 has test `tests/a_spec.rs::s02` and red `def5678`

specs.description: A scenario whose behaviour changed loses its test and red
specs.given: a previous spec whose S03 has test `tests/a_spec.rs::s03` and red `abc1234`, and an accepted spec whose S03 differs only in its `then`
specs.then: the returned S03 has no test and no red, and carries the accepted `then`

specs.description: A change to any one compared field drops the binding
specs.given: for each of decision, kind, description, given and when in turn, a previous S04 with a test and red and an accepted S04 that differs from it in that field alone
specs.then: in every case the returned S04 has no test and no red

specs.description: A new scenario gains no test, even when the previous spec has a red
specs.given: a previous spec with spec-level red `def5678` and no scenario S09, and an accepted spec that adds S09
specs.then: the returned S09 has no test and no red

specs.description: Re-accepting keeps the seal of a file whose tests all belong to unchanged scenarios
specs.given: an accepted spec sealed over `tests/a_spec.rs` and `tests/a_spec_2.rs`, where only a scenario tested in `tests/a_spec_2.rs` has changed
specs.when: `hexa spec accept` accepts the changed spec
specs.then: the written spec keeps the seal of `tests/a_spec.rs` with its hash unchanged, drops the seal of `tests/a_spec_2.rs`, and the unchanged scenarios keep their tests and red commits

specs.description: Removing a scenario drops the seal of the file that held its test
specs.given: an accepted spec sealed over `tests/a_spec.rs`, which holds the test of S05, and a changed spec that removes S05
specs.when: `hexa spec accept` accepts the changed spec
specs.then: the written spec no longer seals `tests/a_spec.rs` and no scenario names S05's test while the seal of a file holding only unchanged scenarios' tests is kept, hash unchanged.

specs.description: Rebinding never alters behaviour and carries a binding only across an identical scenario
specs.given: any previous spec and any accepted spec
specs.then: the result's accepted_content equals the accepted spec's accepted_content, and each result scenario has a test exactly when previous holds a scenario with the same id and the same decision, kind, description, given, when and then that has a test; that test and red (or previous's spec-level red if its own is unset) are the ones carried

specs.description: without_tests removes a named test with its docs and attributes and keeps the rest
specs.given: a source with `/// doc` and `#[test]` `#[ignore]` above `fn s03() {…}`, followed by `#[test] fn s04() {…}`
specs.then: the result has no `fn s03`, no `/// doc` line and none of s03's attributes, and `#[test] fn s04() {…}` remains byte for byte

specs.description: without_tests leaves alone what only looks like the named test
specs.given: a source holding a helper `fn s03_helper()` that is not a test, a string literal containing `fn s03()`, a comment mentioning `s03`, and no `#[test] fn s03`

specs.description: Re-proving named scenarios writes a new file, binds and seals it, removes the old tests, in one commit
specs.given: an accepted spec for a crate holding `tests/adr_spec.rs` with sealed test `s15b`, and no `tests/adr_spec_2.rs`
specs.when: `hexa spec tests <ADR> --only S15b --because "one reply is no longer enough"` runs
specs.then: a test for S15b is written to `tests/adr_spec_2.rs`, proved red, S15b names it and its red commit, both files are sealed, `s15b` and its docs and attributes are gone from `tests/adr_spec.rs`, and one commit holds it all with a message naming both files and the reason

specs.description: Re-proving a scenario that still has a test requires a reason
specs.given: an accepted spec whose scenario S15b has a sealed test
specs.then: it is refused, no file is written or removed, the spec is unchanged and nothing is committed, and the refusal names `--because`.

specs.description: A scenario left without a test by re-acceptance may be named without a reason
specs.given: an accepted spec whose S03 has no test after rebinding, and existing files `tests/adr_spec.rs` and `tests/adr_spec_2.rs`
specs.then: S03's test is written to `tests/adr_spec_3.rs`, proved red, bound and sealed, and no other test file is changed

specs.description: Scenarios not named are not regenerated or rebound
specs.given: an accepted spec with sealed scenarios S01 and S02
specs.then: S01's test, red commit and test function are unchanged, and the new file holds a test for S02 only

specs.description: without_tests removes exactly the named test functions
specs.given: any Rust source and any list of names
specs.then: the result holds no `#[test]` function whose name is in names, every other item of the source remains unchanged in its order, and without_tests(source, []) equals the source

specs.description: A test that did not build at its red commit is red when the new file builds at HEAD
specs.given: a generated test that calls a function absent at commit `abc1234`, and a new test file that builds at HEAD
specs.when: the test is proved with `--red-at abc1234`
specs.then: the test counts as red at `abc1234` and the scenario is bound with that red commit, as `hexa spec verify --prove` would count it

specs.description: A test that builds and passes at the red commit is refused
specs.given: a generated test that builds and passes at commit `abc1234`
specs.when: the test is proved with `--red-at abc1234`
specs.then: it is refused as not red, and no scenario is bound to it, and the refusal names the test that passed at the red commit.

specs.description: A failure to build is not red when the new file does not build at HEAD
specs.given: a generated test that does not build at `abc1234`, in a new test file that also does not build at HEAD
specs.when: the test is proved with `--red-at abc1234`
specs.then: it is refused, and no scenario is bound to it, and the refusal says the new file does not build at HEAD.

amendments.by: gary (run by Claude on gary's instruction)
amendments.reason: add the lint header hexa gives generated test files, #![allow(unused, clippy::all)], so CI clippy -D warnings passes; no test changed
